title: Opening: interview aims and Willie Humphrey, family friend
summary: The interviewer explains he wants biographies and a feel for the time, mentioning musical families (Marrero, Barbarin, Humphrey). Eddie says Willie Humphrey is an old family friend and that the interviewer freelances for New Orleans Magazine.
